authorized_scope: The user authorized publishing GRU–LSTM–TCN as the principal JBook terna while preserving historical evidence and study counts.

scope.review: Continuous volatility or variance forecasting in any cryptocurrency.
scope.experiment: Bitcoin BTCUSDT, Binance Spot, daily OHLCV.

selection_basis: S1, an original published paper, compares all three families independently for Bitcoin volatility in Table 2.
S8, an original published chapter, provides additional independent GRU and LSTM comparisons in Table 1.
Compact explicit project recipes control capacity without claiming a global minimum or exact reproduction of fitted paper architectures.
Compare GRU with two gates and an integrated state, LSTM with three gates and separate cell memory, and a causal dilated residual TCN.
unmet_or_partial_criteria: TCN has one strict reference out of seven; widespread recurrence is not established.
The terna is not the corpus frequency top three: the Transformer encoder has 2/7 references, compared with TCN 1/7.
The decision to publish followed inspection of the private experiment; those results are not independent prospective validation of the selection.
Fixed inherited recipes do not represent equivalently optimized architecture families.

common_project_contract.target: sigma7: population SD of seven daily log returns, ddof=0, no annualization
common_project_contract.preprocessing: Relative-window OHLC, log1p(volume), and scalers fitted only on permitted training observations.
common_project_contract.development_status: Previously observed 2024 calendar; exploratory comparison of fixed recipes.

models.own_architecture: One unidirectional GRU layer, H=32; last hidden state, dropout, Linear(32,1), Softplus.
models.candidate_projection: New/candidate projection; this is not a third control gate.
models.mechanism: Gated recurrence with an integrated state.
limits: Family recurrence is descriptive of the recovered corpus, not an unbiased prevalence estimate.
The project H=32 recipe is not an exact reproduction of S1 or S8.

models.own_architecture: One unidirectional LSTM layer, H=32; last hidden state, dropout, Linear(32,1), Softplus.
models.candidate_projection: Cell candidate transformation; this is not a fourth control gate.
models.memory: Separate cell state c and hidden state h.
models.mechanism: Gated recurrence with separate cell memory.
limits: Family count includes BiLSTM in S2 and unspecified direction in S8.
The proposed LSTM of S9 raises empirical presence to 6/7 but does not raise strict reference frequency.
The project H=32 recipe is not the winning recipe from S1 or S8.

models.own_architecture: Three residual blocks with two causal Conv1D layers each; H=16, k=3, block dilations 1/2/4; last time position, dropout, Linear(16,1), Softplus.
models.residual_projection: First block: pointwise 1x1 projection from p=5 to H=16.
models.readout: Last observed time position; no global average pooling.
models.support_note: RF=29 covers D=7/14/21/28. Support before each window is zero padding, not additional observations.
limits: Only one independently verified reference in the seven-study corpus; widespread recurrence is not established.
Compact project adaptation, not the S1 winner with six levels, F=287, k=5.
This is not a renaming or reproduction of the historical two-convolution CNN1D.
The dimensionally unspecified CNN in S8 does not add TCN evidence.

sources.title: Ask “Who”, Not “What”: Bitcoin Volatility Forecasting with Twitter Data
locations: Table 2: independent GRU, LSTM and TCN references.
sources.role_separation: D-TCN is the proposed advanced model, not an additional independent TCN reference.

sources.title: Artificial Neural Networks for Realized Volatility Prediction in Cryptocurrency Time Series

search_activity_of_this_selection_update: No bibliographic queries executed; reused verified originals and existing extractions.
disallowed_inferences: All seven studies are peer reviewed.
A DOI proves article indexing or Q1.
The exact project recipes were copied from the papers.
Historical MLP/CNN metrics are GRU/TCN metrics.
The portable public adapter was the original privately executed file.

own_results_context.scope: Previously observed development calendar; conditional training variability, not prospective market confirmation.
